items.title: HB 1198 Introduced
items.description: Relating to a temporary exemption from ad valorem taxation of the appraised value of an improvement to a residence homestead that is completely destroyed by a flood or windstorm.

items.title: HB 1199 Introduced
items.description: Relating to the regulation of elevator mechanics, elevator apprentices, and contractors; requiring an occupational registration.
